# Preface {.unnumbered}

The topic of this course includes statistical inference, Multivariate normal distribution, distribution of quadratic forms, linear models, regression models and experimental design models.

The course moves from Gaussian linear-model theory to regression, experimental comparisons, and model checking. [Chapter 6](06.qmd) distinguishes outliers, leverage, and influence. [Chapter 7](07.qmd) develops transformations and variable selection, including ridge and lasso. Later units develop experimental design, broader model checks, prediction assessment, and logistic regression. Poisson regression and fuller GLM theory remain supplementary reading. Advanced extensions are collected under **Optional topic**.

**Prerequisites**

Math 4751/6751 Mathematical Statistics I and Math 4752/6752 Mathematics and Statistics II.

**Optional topic**

Students interested in extensions can read [Quantile Regression](App_F-quantile-regression.qmd), [Mixed-Effects Models](App_G-mixed-effects.qmd), and [Contrasts and Estimable Comparisons](App_I-contrasts.qmd). These readings include explanations, graphical examples, R code, and further reading; they are supplementary to the scheduled chapters.

## Recommended Textbooks

- Ding, Peng. *Linear Model and Extensions*. CRC Press, 2027.  [arXiv link](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.00649)

- Montgomery, Douglas C., Elizabeth A. Peck, and G. Geoffrey Vining. *Introduction to Linear Regression Analysis*. John Wiley & Sons, 2021. [@montgomery:2021:book]

- Seber, George AF, and Alan J. Lee. *Linear Regression Analysis*. John Wiley & Sons, 2003. [@seber:2003:book]

## Side Readings
